provider: crt.sh certificate transparency search (AList and OpenList hostnames)

free_tier.stated: not stated: crt.sh is a public certificate transparency search with a JSON output and prints no allowance, quota or price

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; it is a search over issued certificates

retention.stated: a certificate stays listed after it expires; exclude=expired limits a query to certificates that are still valid

egress.terms: no egress; it is a search answer, and one prefix query returned a JSON body of several hundred KB

tooling: GET https://crt.sh/?q=alist.PREFIX%25&output=json&exclude=expired, one query per next character; a read client needs no login. The hostnames then go through GET /api/public/settings and GET /api/me on each host; the listing step is a POST that a GET-only probe cannot make
chaining: a hostname list for the capability probe in the public-instances protocol, to be run after the hosted index lists (bangumi.tv, kuhehe.github.io) and in addition to them

limits.value: a single wildcard query alist.%25 returned a truncated result set (the four known hosts alist.qsesvick.top, alist.tianmoy.cn, alist.shenzjd.com and alist.jiejingfan.vip were all missing from it) and crt.sh answered 502, 404 or no reply on many attempts; one query per next character, retried, was needed

identity_cost.detail: an open search page and JSON endpoint, read with no account

reliability_note: crt.sh answered HTTP 502, 404 or no reply on a share of its requests and needed repeated tries; a hostname in CT is a certificate, not a live instance.

evidence.proved: the prefix query alist.a%25 with exclude=expired returns certificates whose names carry an alist label, such as the wildcard *.alist.anhdv.workers.dev
the prefix query openlist.a%25 with exclude=expired returns certificates whose names carry an openlist label, such as openlist.akz.cc.cd
a direct query for a known instance finds its certificate, so the instance is in CT even where the broad alist.%25 query did not return it
a hostname found only through CT, openlist.011206.xyz, answers GET /api/me with an enabled guest session, which is step 1 of the instance protocol
the stored CT hostname list holds 7447 lines, one distinct hostname with an alist or openlist label each
the stored list of hosts that answered GET /api/public/settings holds 2356 lines
the stored list of guest-enabled hosts holds 588 lines
the stored guest-enabled host list holds 588 lines

notes: Certificate transparency lists hosts whose name starts with alist or openlist, including hosts that no forum or GitHub index names. It holds 7447 distinct hostnames with such a label (wildcard form included), 4 with an existing record. Of these, 2356 return the AList or OpenList envelope on GET /api/public/settings and 588 an enabled guest session on GET /api/me, so 586 new hostnames pass steps 0 and 1. The listing step (POST /api/fs/list) is not done, so none counts as a readable instance. Hosts named pan, cloud or share are not reachable by this channel.
binding_note: crt.sh throttles and truncates wide wildcard queries, so a prefix partition is required and the result is a lower bound.
